faq: Do you contact buyers outside Amazon?
Never. Amazon requires all buyer communication to go through its messaging, and we follow that. We also do not ask buyers for reviews, or offer anything in exchange for one.
Can you issue refunds and returns?
Yes, in line with your policy and a refund limit you set. For amounts above it, we ask you first. We never change your bank or payout details.
Will buyer messages meet Amazon's 24 hour rule?
Amazon expects a reply within 24 hours. During the sprint we check your messages on working days and reply inside that window. If you need weekend cover, the add-on or a monthly plan can provide it.
If Amazon loses or damages your stock in its warehouse, you may be owed a refund. We check your reports for such cases and file claims with the evidence. Amazon decides each one.
desc:
Amazon order support, returns and buyer messages need quick, careful handling inside Amazon's rules. Ecom Swift LLC works through your open order issues in Seller Central, answers buyers, processes returns under your policy and prepares reimbursement claims.

## What is Amazon order support?

Order support is the daily work that happens after a buyer clicks purchase. It includes answering buyer messages, checking late or missing parcels, handling return requests and refunds, and claiming back money for stock Amazon loses or damages. For sellers who ship their own orders it covers the whole delivery chain. For sellers using Fulfilled by Amazon it focuses on messages, returns and claims.

## Why slow replies cost more than time

Amazon expects sellers to respond to buyer messages promptly, and it measures how well you handle orders. A buyer who waits for an answer can open a claim, leave negative feedback or ask Amazon to step in. Each of those signals can affect your account standing and the visibility of your listings.

A calm, helpful reply often ends the matter. A short message that confirms the problem, offers a clear fix and stays polite keeps most cases small. Careless wording, or a message that asks the buyer to contact you elsewhere, can create bigger problems.

## How good order handling protects your account

Returns, refunds and messages feed the order defect measures that Amazon reviews. Handling them on time keeps those measures healthy and protects your ability to sell. Careful claims work also recovers money. When Amazon loses or damages stock in a warehouse, you may be able to claim the value back, but only if the claim is filed correctly and with the right evidence.

There is a business benefit too. Buyers who receive a clear and respectful answer are more likely to buy from you again, and clear replies reduce repeat questions. We make no promises about feedback or ratings.

## What a full order desk includes

- Replies to buyer messages written in a polite, policy-safe tone.
- A review of open order issues and unshipped orders.
- Flags for orders at risk of shipping late.
- Returns approved and processed under your return policy.
- Reimbursement claims prepared for lost and damaged stock.
- Saved replies for common situations such as delays, damage and wrong items.
- A guide on wording that Amazon allows and wording to avoid.
- A weekly routine for checking messages and returns.
- A hand-off guide so a helper can continue the work.

## How we handle your orders

We begin with a review of open cases, unanswered messages and pending returns. We sort them by urgency, then reply and resolve them inside Seller Central. Where you grant the access, we aim to answer within Amazon's response window, and we keep every conversation inside Amazon's messaging system, as the rules require.

Refunds and returns follow the policy you set. We prepare claims with the shipment and inventory records Amazon asks for. At the end we send a summary of what happened. The Basic, Standard and Premium packages grow in the number of messages and returns handled, and the highest includes claims for lost and damaged stock plus a hand-off guide.

## What to do and what to avoid

**Do:**
- Tell us your return policy and how you want refunds handled.
- Answer buyers politely, even when the complaint seems unfair.
- Keep delivery proof and shipping records.
- Reply to every message, including thank-you notes.
- File claims within the period Amazon allows.

**Avoid:**
- Asking buyers to contact you by email, phone or social media.
- Offering a refund in exchange for a changed review.
- Ignoring a message because it seems minor.
- Sending the same reply to every case without reading it.
- Delaying claims until the window has closed.

## Who this is for

This service suits a seller who is behind on messages and wants a clean slate. It also suits an owner who suspects Amazon has lost stock but has never filed a claim. A growing brand that plans to hire a helper can use the hand-off guide to train them.

## What we need from you

Please send your return policy, your usual shipping times and any tone preferences for buyer replies. You invite us as a user in your Seller Central account with permissions for messages and returns. We never ask for your password, and we do not contact buyers outside Amazon.
